services.name: 90 Minute Sail
services.desc: Come aboard and experience the "private yacht feel" on one of our San Francisco Bay sails! Duration: 90m minutes About Avoid the crowds on larger boats with a maximum of 18 passengers per trip. The San Francisco Sailing Company offers the unique experience of sailing on the San Francisco Bay aboard a private yacht. Trips depart from Pier 39 in San Francisco's historic Fisherman's Wharf district every 7 days a week from March to November. The crew is available to answer any of your questions, serve you drinks, take photos, and they'll even play music you want. Don't miss out on the beauty and peacefulness of the San Francisco Bay! Book your 1 ½ hour cruise today! Highlights Include: Sail
